summary.text: Brandon Voas is a Democratic state representative from District 57 who took office on January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Voas was born in and lives in Cumberland, Rhode Island, graduated from Cumberland High School and earned a liberal arts degree from the Community College of Rhode Island, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as the parts director for Nucar Volkswagen.
